description: Resolve a DOI to its preprint-to-journal crosswalk record — preprint DOI, journal DOI, journal name, published date, and corresponding author details — from either side: a preprint DOI (10.1101/ or 10.64898/) finds the journal article it was published as, and any other DOI is read as a journal article's and finds the bioRxiv or medRxiv preprint it was posted as. Use when biorxiv_get_preprint shows a `publishedJournalDoi` and you need the journal details, or when you hold a journal article and want its preprint. bioRxiv and medRxiv share their DOI prefixes, so server="both" (the default) checks both in parallel and the response reports which server answered. When the crosswalk holds no record for a published preprint, the journal DOI still comes back from the preprint's own record, without journal name or date, and a notice says so. Returns a not-found error when no server holds the preprint, it lists no journal version, or no preprint is recorded for the journal DOI.

doi.description: DOI to resolve: a preprint DOI (e.g. 10.1101/2024.01.15.575123 or 10.64898/2026.05.07.723463) or a journal article DOI (e.g. 10.1016/j.cell.2020.01.001). A doi.org or biorxiv.org/medrxiv.org article URL or a doi: prefix is accepted and stripped to the bare DOI, as is a vN, .full, or .pdf suffix; a journal DOI keeps its own components (10.7554/eLife.55185.sa1 is not 10.7554/eLife.55185). Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory Press journal DOIs (10.1101/gr.…, 10.1101/gad.…, 10.1101/lm.…) share the preprint prefix and cannot be resolved by DOI.

server.description: Server the preprint was posted on. "both" (default) checks bioRxiv and medRxiv in parallel — use it when the DOI alone does not tell you which server holds the preprint.

name: biorxiv_get_published_version

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `doi_not_found`: No attempted server holds the preprint, neither the crosswalk nor its preprint record lists a journal version, or the crosswalk links no preprint to the journal DOI given. `invalid_doi_format`: The input does not match the 10.NNNN/ DOI pattern, even after URL, doi:, and suffix stripping. `upstream_unavailable`: No published record was established and at least one crosswalk or preprint lookup failed against api.biorxiv.org. `rate_limited`: No published record was established and at least one crosswalk or preprint lookup was rejected with HTTP 429 by api.biorxiv.org. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Present when publishedDoi came from the preprint's own record because the crosswalk had none: says why publishedJournal and publishedDate are absent.

preprintDate.description: Preprint posting date (YYYY-MM-DD) from the crosswalk record, or from the preprint's first revision when the crosswalk has none — the first posting for most preprints. medRxiv records some 10.64898/ preprints twice with different posting dates; this is the first record listed.

preprintDoi.description: The preprint DOI, in bare form: the input itself when it was a preprint DOI, or the preprint the crosswalk links to the input when it was a journal DOI.

publishedDate.description: Journal publication date (YYYY-MM-DD). Absent when the crosswalk holds no record for this preprint — see notice.

publishedJournal.description: Name of the publishing journal. Absent when the crosswalk holds no record for this preprint — see notice.

server.description: The server that returned this published record — never "both".

title: Get Published Journal Version
